wishes: Сделай набор карточек для коллекции «Кино»: жанр — космическое приключение. Пожелания: светло и по-доброму, без страшных пришельцев, больше предметов, чем локаций. 3 варианта. (EN: genre space adventure; bright and kind, no scary aliens, more objects than locations; 3 variants. No set name was given, so the agent chose one.)
notes: How the wishes are applied: bright and kind = sunny or brightly lit backdrops (A has one sunrise and one Moon-night accent, B and C are all day); no aliens at all (no characters anyway), only a friendly empty saucer in B. More objects than locations = at most one place card per variant, the category 4 scenes show objects (vehicles, a dish, a garden) in their setting, and variant C uses 2 category 4 scenes instead of 3.

variants.concept: Moon Mission: a retro space-race trip to the Moon, told through the crew's kit and the rocket
variants.moment: On a sunny launch day the crew suits up, packs their tube lunches and rides a red-and-white rocket to a friendly Moon.

cards.name: Mission Patch
cards.subject: A round embroidered astronaut mission patch drawn as a thick, chunky, padded disc: a navy-blue centre with a small red-and-white retro rocket flying upward and a thick golden stitched rim, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view so its thickness shows; bold, simple shapes and no text anywhere.
cards.unique_detail: the rocket on the patch leaves a short curved trail of three tiny white stars
cards.main_colors: navy-blue centre, red-and-white rocket, golden rim
cards.background: Bright warm orange background with a smooth light-to-deep gradient, soft radiating light rays and a scattering of small white five-pointed stars centred behind the patch (the set motif), clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: Every mission starts with its patch: a small, unmistakable astronaut prop that opens the set and carries the star motif.

cards.name: Tube Lunch
cards.subject: An astronaut's lunch tray seen from slightly above, standing on a plain flat surface: a chunky rounded white tray holding three plump space-food squeeze tubes side by side (soft silver tubes with big round red, yellow and green caps, each printed with one big simple fruit picture: a red strawberry, a yellow banana, a green apple) and one small silver drink pouch with a bendy straw, all clipped neatly into the tray.
cards.unique_detail: one tube is gently squeezed, so a little curl of bright strawberry-pink puree peeks out of its open cap
cards.main_colors: white tray, silver tubes with red, yellow and green caps
cards.background: Category 2: a plain flat surface and a plain wall in the same bright sky-blue family, the surface clearly lighter than the wall, a smooth gradient on the wall and no stripes or pattern; bright even daylight.
cards.why: Space food in tubes is the classic astronaut meal: small, funny and read as space at once. Review change: the first image read as paint tubes in a palette, so each tube now shows a fruit.

cards.name: Astro Boots
cards.subject: A pair of chunky white astronaut boots standing side by side on a plain flat surface, in three-quarter view: puffy rounded uppers, thick soft blue soles and a wide bright orange strap with a big round silver buckle across each ankle; smooth, clean surfaces.
cards.unique_detail: a small round blue badge with a white star on the side of each boot
cards.main_colors: white boots with thick blue soles and orange ankle straps
cards.background: Category 2: a plain flat surface and a plain wall in the same warm sunny-yellow family, the surface clearly lighter than the wall, a smooth gradient and no pattern; bright even light.
cards.why: The astronaut's big puffy boots, the ones that leave the first footprints on the Moon; a medium prop for the early cards.

cards.name: Countdown
cards.subject: A friendly retro launch-control console standing on a glossy floor: a rounded white desk-shaped cabinet with a sloped top that holds one big round green radar screen, three big chunky round buttons (red, yellow and blue) and one chunky lever with a red ball handle; bold, sparse controls and no text or numbers anywhere.
cards.unique_detail: the radar screen shows one simple bright rocket shape climbing toward a crescent moon
cards.main_colors: white cabinet with red, yellow and blue buttons and a green screen
cards.background: Category 3: a glossy pale-lilac floor with a soft reflection under the console, and behind it a plain vertical wall in rich purple with a smooth gradient and subtle soft rays centred behind the console; no props, no lights.
cards.why: The countdown is the heart of launch day; a big, simple control desk reads as mission control.

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A classic round white astronaut helmet with a big curved golden visor, a thick white neck ring and a red stripe across the top, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; a chunky, solid, smooth silhouette that fills the frame, empty inside.
cards.unique_detail: the golden visor reflects a tiny crescent moon and two little stars
cards.main_colors: white shell with a golden visor and a red stripe
cards.background: Bright warm orange background with a smooth gradient, soft concentric rings centred behind the helmet and a few small white five-pointed stars around it (the set motif), clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The astronaut's helmet is the single most iconic object of a space adventure; a signature card.

cards.name: Jetpack
cards.subject: A chunky retro jetpack floating in three-quarter view: two plump rounded silver rocket tanks with bright red fins and red nose caps, joined by a white back plate with two thick padded shoulder straps, and two short soft white vapour puffs under the nozzles; smooth clean surfaces and no small parts.
cards.unique_detail: a small golden star badge in the middle of the back plate
cards.main_colors: silver tanks with red fins, white back plate
cards.background: Bright sunny-yellow background with a smooth gradient and a pattern of small soft-orange five-pointed stars (the set motif) centred behind the jetpack, clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The jetpack is the dream gadget of every space adventure; a fun signature card.

cards.name: Moon Rock
cards.subject: A precious moon rock on display: a chunky, rounded, pale silvery-cream rock with two or three smooth round craters and two small sparkling crystal points, so it reads as a piece of the Moon, under a clear glass dome that stands on a polished dark-wood museum plinth; the rock is big and central inside the dome.
cards.unique_detail: a small golden star set into the front of the plinth
cards.main_colors: pale silvery-cream rock under clear glass, dark-wood plinth
cards.background: Category 3: a polished dark-wood museum plinth with a soft reflection under the glass dome; behind it a plain vertical wall in fresh leaf-green with a smooth gradient and subtle rings centred behind the dome; no props, no lights.
cards.why: The treasure the crew brings home from the Moon: a precious object for a 4-star slot. Review change: the first image showed a purple lump on a plain podium that read as category 2, so the rock now has craters and the dome stands on a wooden plinth.

cards.name: Radar Dish
cards.subject: The space centre's big tracking dish: a huge round white dish antenna tilted up toward the sky on a chunky white-and-red base, standing firmly on a wide band of bright green grass; low camera so it looks big and heroic.
cards.unique_detail: a little red light glows at the tip of the dish's centre antenna
cards.main_colors: white dish with a red base
cards.background: Category 4 scene on a bright sunny day: a wide band of bright green grass across the bottom with a soft rounded hill line, and an open bright blue sky with a few soft white clouds; simple and bright.
cards.why: The giant dish that listens to the crew all the way to the Moon; a big, friendly object in its setting rather than a place.

cards.name: Blast Off!
cards.subject: A classic retro rocket at the moment of ignition, standing on its launch pad: a tall, chunky red-and-white rocket with three rounded fins and a round porthole, big soft billowing white vapour clouds rolling out at its base and a short bright flame under the engine; low camera so the rocket soars and stays the clear centre.
cards.unique_detail: a small golden star painted on the rocket's nose cone
cards.main_colors: red-and-white rocket
cards.background: Category 4 scene at sunrise: a wide flat launch pad of warm sand-coloured stone and green grass across the bottom, big soft white vapour clouds, and a glowing warm orange-and-pink sunrise sky behind the rocket; bright and saturated, never dark, and the rocket itself brightly lit.
cards.why: Ignition is the big thrill of the mission; the iconic rocket at a golden sunrise leads into the climax.

cards.name: Moon Landing
cards.subject: A friendly lunar lander standing on the Moon: a chunky golden-foil body with a rounded white cabin on top, one round window and four sturdy spread legs with round footpads, standing firmly on a wide band of soft pale-cream moon dust with gentle round craters; low camera so the lander looks big and heroic.
cards.unique_detail: a neat trail of round boot prints leading away from the lander's ladder
cards.main_colors: golden lander with a white cabin
cards.background: Category 4 scene at night on the Moon: a wide band of soft pale-cream moon dust with gentle round craters across the bottom, and above it a clear deep-blue starry sky with a big, bright blue-and-green Earth glowing in it; bright and saturated, never black or murky, and the lander brightly lit.
cards.context_cue: a small plain white flag with one golden star on a short pole, planted beside the lander
cards.why: The climax: the crew has landed on the Moon and planted its star flag, the payoff of the whole mission.

variants.concept: Friendly Planet: the crew explores a candy-coloured alien world with explorer gadgets, alien wonders and their little flying saucer
variants.moment: The crew's little flying saucer lands on a sunny, candy-coloured planet, and they set out to explore its gentle wonders.

cards.name: Star Map
cards.subject: A chunky, rolled-open explorer's star map floating with a slight tilt: a thick cream parchment sheet curling into a fat roll at both ends, showing four big bright blue stars and one small ringed planet joined by a dotted red path; bold, simple shapes and no text.
cards.unique_detail: the dotted path ends at the ringed planet with one small golden star
cards.main_colors: cream parchment with bright blue stars and a red dotted path
cards.background: Rich violet-purple background with a smooth light-to-deep gradient and a pattern of small pale-lilac ringed planets (the set motif) centred behind the map, clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: Every exploration starts with a map of the stars; a small, unmistakable space-explorer prop.

cards.name: Space Scanner
cards.subject: A chunky handheld space scanner standing upright on a plain flat surface: a rounded white body with a bright red grip, a big round glowing green screen that shows one simple ringed-planet shape, and a short bendy antenna with a round yellow ball on the tip; smooth clean surfaces, few big shapes, no text.
cards.unique_detail: the antenna's yellow tip is shaped like a tiny star
cards.main_colors: white body with a red grip and a green screen
cards.background: Category 2: a plain flat surface and a plain wall in the same warm sunny-yellow family, the surface clearly lighter than the wall, a smooth gradient and no pattern; bright even light.
cards.why: The explorer's gadget for reading a new planet; a small sci-fi prop that says space explorers at once.

cards.name: Planet Pop
cards.subject: A big round lollipop shaped like a little ringed planet, floating with a slight tilt: a glossy candy ball swirled in bright pink and lilac, circled by a chunky golden sugar ring, on a short thick white stick; smooth, solid and chunky.
cards.unique_detail: a tiny white sugar star stuck to the candy planet like a little moon
cards.main_colors: pink and lilac candy ball with a golden ring
cards.background: Bright sky-blue background with a smooth gradient and soft radiating light rays centred behind the lollipop, clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The crew's favourite treat is a sweet shaped like a planet: playful and kind, and it carries the ringed-planet motif.

cards.name: Star Jar
cards.subject: A chunky round glass jar with a thick cork stopper and a short twine bow, standing on a polished wooden tabletop, holding three plump glowing golden stars of different sizes; clear glass with crisp highlights.
cards.unique_detail: the smallest star is pressed against the glass as if peeking out
cards.main_colors: clear glass jar with glowing golden stars and a brown cork
cards.background: Category 3: a polished warm honey-wood tabletop with a soft reflection under the jar; behind it a plain vertical wall in rich violet-purple with a smooth gradient; the stars glow only inside the jar, with no glow on the wall; no props.
cards.why: A jar of stars collected on the trip: a small, magical souvenir that only a space adventure could have.

cards.name: Hover Bike
cards.subject: A friendly sci-fi hover bike floating in three-quarter view: a smooth, rounded, bubble-shaped mint-green and white body with no wheels at all, a curved clear windscreen, a padded white seat, two short swept-back side fins and two round jet pods underneath with a soft blue glow kept inside them; chunky and smooth, clearly a space vehicle and not a scooter or a motorbike.
cards.unique_detail: a little ringed-planet emblem on the nose
cards.main_colors: mint-green and white body with chrome trim
cards.background: Bright candy-pink background with a smooth gradient and a pattern of small paler-pink ringed planets (the set motif) centred behind the hover bike, clearly visible; no glow on the background; bright daylight.
cards.why: The explorers' ride across the new planet: a fun signature vehicle with no wheels, because it floats. Review change: the first image read as a vintage scooter, which is a card of Love in the City, so the object is now a sci-fi hover bike.

cards.name: Explorer Helmet
cards.subject: A rounded white space explorer's helmet standing on a plain flat surface in three-quarter view: a smooth, chunky white shell with a big curved clear glass visor across the front (empty inside), a thick bright blue neck ring at the bottom and two short antennas on the sides with round yellow ball tips; clearly a helmet you wear.
cards.unique_detail: a small yellow ringed-planet badge on the forehead of the helmet
cards.main_colors: white shell with a clear visor and a bright blue neck ring
cards.background: Category 2: a plain flat surface and a plain wall in the same warm orange family, the surface clearly lighter than the wall, a smooth gradient and no pattern; bright even light.
cards.why: The storybook space explorer's helmet: friendly and instantly sci-fi. Review change: the first image, a fishbowl bubble helmet, read as a glass dome or a cake cover, so the helmet now has a shell, a visor and antennas.

cards.name: Glow Bloom
cards.subject: A rare alien flower in a pot, standing on a glossy round white podium: one big flower with plump, glossy, bright pink star-shaped petals around a round golden centre, on a thick curving green stem with two broad leaves and two short curly feelers tipped with small glowing round buds, in a round white pot.
cards.unique_detail: the pot is a little ringed planet with a golden ring around its middle
cards.main_colors: bright pink petals, golden centre, green stem, white pot
cards.background: Category 3: a glossy round white podium with a soft reflection under the pot; behind it a plain vertical wall in fresh leaf-green with a smooth gradient and subtle rings centred behind the flower; the buds glow only inside themselves; no props.
cards.why: The planet's rarest wonder, a friendly flower nobody on Earth has seen; a precious 4-star find.

cards.name: Dune Rover
cards.subject: A friendly six-wheeled explorer rover crossing the planet: a chunky white-and-orange body with a round-windowed cabin, six big round chunky blue wheels and a short mast with a round dish, standing firmly on a wide band of smooth golden-orange sand dunes; low camera so it looks big and heroic.
cards.unique_detail: a small yellow ringed-planet flag on the back of the rover
cards.main_colors: white-and-orange body with chunky blue wheels
cards.background: Category 4 scene on a bright sunny day on a friendly alien planet: a wide band of smooth golden-orange sand dunes across the bottom, and a bright candy-pink sky with two small pale moons and a few soft clouds; simple and bright.
cards.why: The explorers' rover crossing the dunes: the adventure on the ground, shown as an object in its setting.

cards.name: Base Camp
cards.subject: The explorers' cosy base camp: a round white dome habitat with a big round orange door, two round windows glowing warm yellow, a short antenna with a ball tip and a small solar panel beside it, standing firmly on a wide band of soft lilac grass on a friendly alien planet; low camera so it looks big and inviting.
cards.unique_detail: one round window has a small potted flower on its sill
cards.main_colors: white dome with an orange door and trim
cards.background: Category 4 scene on a bright sunny day on a friendly alien planet: a wide band of soft lilac grass with a few round pink pebbles across the bottom, and an open bright blue sky with soft white clouds and a big pale ringed planet low on the horizon; simple and bright.
cards.why: Home on the new planet: the variant's only place card, cosy and kind.

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: The crew's little flying saucer, landed on a hilltop: a chunky, rounded silver disc ship with a red rim, a clear glass dome on top, a ring of round warm-yellow lights around the rim, three short sturdy landing legs and a small ramp folded down to the grass; low camera so it looks big and heroic; empty, friendly and gleaming.
cards.unique_detail: a small ringed-planet emblem painted on its side
cards.main_colors: silver disc with a red rim and a clear glass dome
cards.background: Category 4 scene on a bright sunny day on a friendly alien planet: a wide band of bright green grass on a rounded hilltop across the bottom, and a glowing violet-purple sky with soft pink clouds and a big ringed planet; bright and saturated, never dark.
cards.why: The climax: the friendly saucer that carried the crew here, gleaming on the hilltop; no aliens needed.

variants.concept: Life in Orbit: a cosy week aboard a space station above the blue Earth, ending with a happy splashdown home
variants.moment: A cosy week aboard a bright space station high above the blue Earth, from floating juice to the happy splashdown home.

cards.name: Juice Bubbles
cards.subject: A puffy silver astronaut drink pouch with a bendy white straw, floating with a slight tilt, filled with bright orange juice that shows through a clear window on its front, with three big round wobbly balls of orange juice floating out of the straw in zero gravity; chunky and simple.
cards.unique_detail: one juice ball is caught mid-wobble, with a bright highlight
cards.main_colors: silver pouch with bright orange juice and a white straw
cards.background: Bright sky-blue background with a smooth light-to-deep gradient and a pattern of small white crescent moons (the set motif) centred behind the pouch, clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: Drinking in zero gravity, where juice floats in balls: a small, funny sight that says space station at once.

cards.name: Astro Glove
cards.subject: One big chunky white astronaut glove standing upright on its wide cuff on a plain flat surface, fingers slightly curled, with a thick bright orange wrist ring and padded fingertips; smooth, clean surfaces and few big shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a small blue crescent-moon patch on the back of the hand
cards.main_colors: white glove with an orange wrist ring
cards.background: Category 2: a plain flat surface and a plain wall in the same bright candy-pink family, the surface clearly lighter than the wall, a smooth gradient and no pattern; bright even light.
cards.why: The spacewalker's glove, chunky and unmistakable; a small everyday prop of life in orbit.

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A classic round satellite floating in three-quarter view: a shiny polished silver ball with four long, thick, swept-back antennas with round red tips and a small round dish on its side; chunky and simple.
cards.unique_detail: a tiny golden crescent moon on the side of the ball
cards.main_colors: polished silver ball with red-tipped antennas
cards.background: Rich violet-purple background with a smooth gradient and a pattern of small pale-lilac crescent moons (the set motif) centred behind the satellite, clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The little satellite that circles the Earth next to the station; an instantly recognisable space shape.

cards.name: Space Treat
cards.subject: An astronaut's freeze-dried ice cream: a chunky block with three neat layers (strawberry pink, vanilla white and chocolate brown) standing half out of an open, softly folded silver foil pouch on a plain flat surface; few big shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a small bite missing from one corner of the block
cards.main_colors: pink, white and chocolate-brown layers in a silver foil pouch
cards.background: Category 2: a plain flat surface and a plain wall in the same fresh leaf-green family, the surface clearly lighter than the wall, a smooth gradient and no pattern; bright even light.
cards.why: Space ice cream is the treat every child knows from astronauts: light, sweet and kind.

cards.name: Orbit Taxi
cards.subject: A small round one-seat space pod standing on three short landing feet on a plain flat surface: a chunky white egg-shaped body with a wide bright red band, one big round glass window on the front (empty inside), two short stubby grabber arms folded in front and small round thrusters; smooth and friendly.
cards.unique_detail: a little red crescent-moon lamp on top that glows softly inside its glass cap
cards.main_colors: white pod with a bright red band
cards.background: Category 2: a plain flat surface and a plain wall in the same warm sunny-yellow family, the surface clearly lighter than the wall, a smooth gradient and no pattern; bright even light.
cards.why: The station's little taxi pod for hops outside: a cute signature vehicle of life in orbit.

cards.name: Telescope
cards.subject: A big white space telescope on a chunky silver tripod, standing on a polished floor and pointing up and to the side: a thick white tube with a bright orange ring at the front, a round eyepiece and a small finder scope; smooth, simple shapes.
cards.unique_detail: the front lens shows a tiny reflection of a crescent moon
cards.main_colors: white tube with an orange ring on a silver tripod
cards.background: Category 3: a polished warm wooden floor with a soft reflection under the tripod; behind it a plain vertical wall in bright candy-pink with a smooth gradient and subtle rings centred behind the telescope; no props, no lights.
cards.why: Stargazing from the station: the crew's telescope, a signature object of any space adventure. Review change: the plain pale floor read as category 2, so the floor is now polished wood.

cards.name: Space Station
cards.subject: A friendly modular space station floating in three-quarter view: three chunky white cylinder modules joined in a T around a round central hub, a small round docking port at the front, round windows along the modules and two wide golden solar-panel wings; smooth, simple and solid, so the whole station fills the frame.
cards.unique_detail: the round windows along the modules glow warm yellow, as if the crew is home
cards.main_colors: white modules with golden solar panels
cards.background: Bright sky-blue background with a smooth light-to-deep gradient, soft concentric rings centred behind the station and a few small white crescent moons (the set motif), clearly visible; bright daylight, never dark space.
cards.why: The crew's home in orbit, shown floating as a station should: the big iconic object of this variant and its only place card. Review change: the first image, a wheel-shaped station, read as a steering wheel at card size, so the station is now made of modules.

cards.name: Shuttle
cards.subject: A chunky white space shuttle orbiter in three-quarter view, resting on its landing gear on a glossy floor: a rounded navy-blue nose, big delta wings with navy-blue edges, a tall tail fin and three round engine bells at the back; smooth, simple shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a small red crescent moon painted on the tail fin
cards.main_colors: white orbiter with a navy-blue nose and wing edges
cards.background: Category 3: a glossy warm-white floor with a soft reflection under the shuttle; behind it a plain vertical wall in warm sunny yellow with a smooth gradient; no props, no lights.
cards.why: The winged ship that carries the crew up to the station: a big, precious vehicle for a 4-star slot.

cards.name: Zero-G Garden
cards.subject: The station's little greenhouse: a round white planter box bursting with three big cheerful sunflowers and a row of plump green lettuces, standing firmly on the station's wide, smooth white deck floor in front of a big round window; low camera so the garden looks big and lush.
cards.unique_detail: one sunflower leans toward the window as if looking at the Earth
cards.main_colors: white planter with yellow sunflowers and green lettuce
cards.background: Category 4 scene inside the bright station: a wide band of smooth white deck floor across the bottom, and behind the garden a big round window filled edge to edge with the bright blue-and-white Earth; evenly lit, bright and cheerful, with no dark space showing.
cards.why: Growing sunflowers in orbit: the warm heart of life on the station, a kind 5-star scene.

cards.name: Splashdown
cards.subject: A space capsule just back home, bobbing on a calm sunny sea: a chunky white cone-shaped capsule with a round window and a bright orange float ring around its base, sitting firmly in the water, with three big red-and-white striped parachutes still billowing above it; low camera so it looks big and heroic.
cards.unique_detail: a little white crescent-moon emblem on the capsule's side
cards.main_colors: white capsule with an orange float ring and red-and-white parachutes
cards.background: Category 4 scene on a bright sunny day: a wide band of clear blue sea with white foam around the capsule across the bottom, and an open bright blue sky with a few soft white clouds; simple and bright.
cards.why: The happy ending: the crew splashes down safely back on Earth, the climax of the voyage.
